{{Color box|{{party color|One Cebu}}|border=darkgray}} [[One Cebu|1CEBU]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Cebu's 1st congressional district''' is one of the seven [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Cebu]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1916 and earlier in the [[Philippine Assembly]] from 1907 to 1916.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 20, 2020 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district consists of the cities of [[Carcar]], [[Naga, Cebu|Naga]] and [[Talisay, Cebu|Talisay]] and the municipalities of [[Minglanilla, Cebu|Minglanilla]], [[San Fernando, Cebu|San Fernando]] and [[Sibonga]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Rhea Gullas]] of the [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|National Unity Party]] (NUP) and [[One Cebu]] (1CEBU).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 20, 2020}} Prior to its second dissolution in 1972, the district encompassed the northeastern municipalities of [[Bogo, Cebu|Bogo]], [[Borbon, Cebu|Borbon]], [[Carmen, Cebu|Carmen]], [[Catmon, Cebu|Catmon]], [[Pilar, Cebu|Pilar]], [[Poro, Cebu|Poro]], [[San Francisco, Cebu|San Francisco]], [[Sogod, Cebu|Sogod]], [[Tabogon]], and [[Tudela, Cebu|Tudela]], and the city of [[Danao, Cebu|Danao]]. ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Legislature ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
